_purpose: What breaks when you change a component. Generated from import analysis of src/components/, hand-annotated.

entries.notes: FormField provides context consumed by FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription and FormMessage. Those five are inseparable.
Uses buttonVariants for AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel styling.
Sheet is Radix Dialog with edge-anchored positioning. Shares all a11y behavior with ui:dialog.
The heaviest composite in the inventory. Changing any dependency affects sidebar rendering on mobile and desktop.
Previous and next controls use buttonVariants.
Toaster is the render host; useToast in src/hooks/use-toast.ts is the queue.
Handle styling depends on border and ring tokens.
Composes the AI button visual language and adds review, loading, complete and error states.
Attribution requires the avatar or an explicit agent name.
Icon-only controls require tooltips for accessible names.

highBlastRadius.reason: buttonVariants is imported by alert-dialog, calendar, carousel and pagination. A variant rename breaks four components silently.
command composes it; sheet shares its Radix primitive and a11y expectations.
Attribution affordance for the whole AI namespace. Its fixed palette is deliberate — see the spec.
